title: Temporary coverage cobbler list — week of 2029-11-23
content:
Purpose: quick, one-week cross-team patchboard to cover shortfalls across routes and to record lightweight handoffs. Not a replacement for long-term rota; ephemeral fixes only.

Legend: [ ] = unassigned, [x] = assigned/claimed, HL = high-latency risk, BKT = backup tester, estCap = estimated capacity delta (tokens/sec)

Columns: Priority | Route (service/endpoint) | Patch owner | Backup | Window (UTC) | estCap | Current blocker / notes | Immediate action items

1 | route: /v1/generate-hosted (eu-west) | [x] Aisha P. | Ethan M. | 2029-11-24 06:00-18:00 | -8% | rolling latency spikes during 2k token sequences; suspected batching misconfiguration on pool-3B. Linked: ENG-4821. | 1) run lightweight profiling script (scripts/latency-probe) by 06:30; 2) if >15% p99 increase, flip policy flag to limit batch size to 2; 3) notify product-monitoring channel.

2 | route: /embeddings-bulk (us-east) | [ ] | Lina C. | 2029-11-25 00:00-12:00 | -12% | heavy embedding bursts from partner integration; need temporary qps cap. | 1) owner to coordinate with partner on soft throttles (partner slack thread #stripe-int); 2) add rule to rate-limiter for prefixed tokens.

3 | route: internal/kv-prefetcher-prod (global) | [x] Marcus O. | Ethan M. | 2029-11-23 23:00-03:00 | +0% (stability patch) | memory leak confirmed on older kernel; short restart window required. Runbook: RNB-77. | 1) perform rolling restart with 30s drain; 2) watch cache-hit rates; 3) escalate if node enters CrashLoop.

4 | route: /chat-stream (ap-south) | [ ] | [ ] | 2029-11-26 08:00-14:00 | -5% | regional GPU shortage (scheduled infra maintenance). Consider routing to fallback model variant mid-window. | 1) product-ops to approve fallback mapping; 2) SRE to pre-warm variant replicas.

5 | route: billing/usage-async (eu-central) | [x] Ethan M. | Lina C. | 2029-11-24 10:00-16:00 | -3% | spikes in batched invoice generation causing downstream timeouts. | 1) reduce batch size for job-runner to 250 records; 2) monitor billing-queue length.

Quick decisions: 
- Approved: temporary batch-size cap on /v1/generate-hosted (if profiling confirms) — Aisha to own toggle.
- Pending: explicit fallback mapping for ap-south chat-stream — product signoff required by 2029-11-25 EOD.

Open questions / risks: 
- Can partner-side embedding bursts be smoothed without contractual change? (ops: flagged to partner PM)
- If multiple route owners are unassigned at rollout time, escalation plan: page product-ops rotation -> assign ad-hoc oncall.

Postmortem / follow-ups (to be filled after window): 
- Owner notes: short bullet list of what changed, timestamps, config diffs, and whether this should be converted to a permanent runbook.

Slack refs: #ops-coverage (pinned msg id 5232), #platform-monitoring.

Quick checklist for owner when claiming a row:
- [ ] confirm in this doc and ping collaborators
- [ ] run pre-change canary locally or on staging (if possible)
- [ ] post change: collect p50/p95/p99 and token throughput snapshot and attach to Confluence page above
- [ ] file follow-up ticket if permanent fix needed (label: coverage-postmortem)

Notes to self: keep this sheet deliberately thin — short life span. If >3 repeated occurrences for same route within 30 days, escalate to dedicated runway planning.

Historical snapshot: kept in linked artifacts (weekly archive folder) — do not overwrite.
